family: KEPT, AND THIS IS THE REASON IT STILL CARRIES A DECISION AND A CONSEQUENCE AFTER ANOTHER BLOCK OF IT: A WANT IS THE BEGINNING UNDER PRESSURE, AN ASK IS THE GOAL A READER CAN STATE, THE REFUSAL OR THE ASK IS THE RESISTANCE, THE DECISION IS THE CHANGE, THE COST OF IT IS THE COMPLETED BEAT, AND WHAT THE OTHER PERSON DOES WITH IT AFTER HE HAS GONE IS THE ENDING THAT OPENS SOMETHING. THE FAMILY IS NOT A SHAPE OF THE CHAPTER AND IT NEVER WAS. IT IS THE SIX THINGS `AGENTS.md` ASKS FOR, AND IT CARRIED THEM ONCE ALREADY, IN 0985 TO 0994, WHERE A MAN DECIDED, PAID AND LEFT THINGS DIFFERENT IN ALL TEN. WHAT IS NEW HERE IS THE WANT'S PRICE, NOT THE FAMILY.

the_protagonist.who: A BUILDER IN HIS EARLY FORTIES WHO WORKS OUT OF THE UNIT AND IS ALSO KNOWN AT THE LOCK-UP. HE IS THE VIEWPOINT IN ALL TEN.
the_protagonist.name: NONE. NO HUMAN PERSONAL NAME ANYWHERE IN THE TEN, INCLUDING FOR HIM. FLAG 3(b) IS A HUMAN'S AND IS NOT SETTLED HERE.
the_protagonist.what_he_wants_and_how_it_changes_in_this: HE WANTS TO BE ON THE BOOK AT THE LOCK-UP AND IN 0080 HE FOUND OUT WHAT A BOOK IS: ONE RULED COLUMN, NAMES AGAINST WORK, AND IT SHUTS AT THE END OF THE SEASON IF THERE IS NO WORK ON IT. IN THIS BLOCK HE FINDS OUT THE SECOND HALF OF THE SENTENCE AND IT IS THE HALF THAT COSTS. HE STARTS THE BLOCK AS A MAN WHO ASKS, AND HE ENDS IT AS A MAN WHO HAS DECIDED TO MAKE SOMEBODY ELSE ASK.
the_protagonist.what_the_price_is_and_this_is_the_prompt: THE PRICE IS A PERSON AND NOT A WALL. TO BE ENTERED HE MUST HAVE WORK SOMEBODY ASKED HIM FOR, IN FRONT OF THE MEN ON THE BOOK, AND THE TWO WOMEN WHO ARE ON IT ARE UP THE RIVER AND THE SEASON IS CLOSING. THE ONLY PERSON LEFT WHO CAN ASK HIM FOR SOMETHING IS THE SISTER AT NUMBER TWELVE, WHO IS THE ONE PERSON IN THIS BLOCK WHO HAS NEVER BEEN ASKED FOR ANYTHING BY ANYBODY, AND WHOSE MOTHER WROTE ON A SHEET ON FRIDAY THAT SHE HAS NOT BEEN ASKED. HE SPENDS HER. THE COST IS ON THE PAGE AT 1003 AND PAID AT 1004.
the_protagonist.what_holds_him_up_as_a_person: HE IS GOOD WITH HIS HANDS AND WRONG ABOUT PEOPLE AND HE KNOWS IT AND IS GETTING WORSE AT IT. HE CARRIES A FOLDING RULE, A PENCIL BEHIND ONE EAR AND A BAG WITH A SHEET IN IT THAT IS NOT HIS. HE HAS A SHOULDER THAT DOES NOT TAKE HEIGHT AND STANDS WITH HIS WEIGHT ON ONE LEG. HE IS RIGHT ABOUT WALLS.
the_protagonist.an_age_discrepancy_on_the_page_and_this_: THE FIGURE AT NUMBER NINE IS GIVEN AS SIXTY-ONE IN HER OWN MOUTH AT 0990, AND THE STANDING FIGURE LIST CARRIES HER AS LATE FIFTIES. BOTH ARE ON THE PAGE AND THEY DO NOT AGREE. NO AGE IS RESTATED IN ANY OF THE TEN CHAPTERS OF THIS BLOCK, WHICH IS THE ONLY ACTION AVAILABLE TO A WRITER, AND THE DISCREPANCY IS FLAGGED HERE FOR A HUMAN.

cards.995: At the unit, in the far end of the store where the rack of sample timber stands against the wall and the ends of the samples have gone the colour of tea, he is alone, because the woman from two doors down has gone up the river on one of the two lines. He has had one piece of work asked of him in a year — a wall out and a doorway through at the lock-up, priced by Friday — and he has not done it and has not put a figure down, and he has been avoiding it for a week because it would have meant being asked. He wants to know what has to be true for the book to take a man, and he decides to go up the frontage and find out, and he takes the job in his bag with him. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: the morning he had set aside, and the knowledge on the page that the only work anybody has ever asked him for is four days of wall. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he is out on the frontage with a job in his bag and no figure against it.
cards.996: At number nine, in the scullery, with the yard door open behind him because she is in the habit of leaving it open, and the street door shut with its hook up, and the hook not touched. The woman who does her shopping has gone up the river on the other line. The floor of the room she was born in is two inches down at the far corner and has been since before she went. He has decided that he will not begin work nobody has asked him for, and he gets himself as far as the back step and stops there, and does not go into the house. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: the floor stays down for six weeks and the woman who owns it does not know. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he has made a rule for himself and the rule is the reason he has never been on a book.
cards.997: At number ten, on the second floor landing, with two iron bed frames standing against the wall in the room off it. The woman of the house, in her early thirties, is alone, her sister having gone up the river with her bag. She wants the frames out so the front room can be opened, and she wants to pay him for it, and she says the paying out loud because she has never asked anybody for anything and paying is the only way she knows how to ask. He takes her money, which he has never taken off any of them. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: he gives up the one thing that has got him into four houses, which is doing it for nothing. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he has been asked for something by a person who had to work at asking, and it is two bed frames, and it will not put him in a book.
cards.998: At the lock-up, in the weighbridge hut, which stands at the weigh end of the yard with a bench down one side and a window looking at the plate. The woman who books work comes through to him. He asks her what a man has to have before the book will keep him, and she tells him: work, and the work asked for, in front of the men on the book, and the men are up a river, and the book shuts at the end of the season. He asks her whether work a man has done on his own can be entered, and she says no, and she gives the reason. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: he has the whole of it in one afternoon and none of it can be used this side of the water. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he knows the price of a line, and the price is a request from somebody with the right to make one, and there is nobody left on this side of the river with the right.
cards.999: At number twelve, on the landing, with the stair going up into the dark and every door off it shut. The old woman has gone up the river and the sister is in the house. She wants him to put a note to the daughter and tell her to come, because her mother is going on Friday by herself and somebody ought to be on the path. He agrees, which takes back the line he set down for the old woman on Wednesday. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: that first line was the only thing the old woman ever chose, and agreeing to this is him choosing for her again in the other direction. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: the sheet in his bag carries three lines and two of them are in his hand and one of them contradicts the other.
cards.1000: At number nine, in the back room, with the bedroom floor dropped at the far corner against the joists underneath. He has come to do a job nobody asked him for, having decided at the coal-house door in the last chapter not to, and he does it. He takes up two boards, finds the joist, and puts the floor back. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: it is the one piece of work that matters on this side of the river while she is away, and nothing on any page anywhere will say that he did it, and there never will be. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he has done the work he wanted to do and it is worth nothing, and he cannot go back to not knowing that.
cards.1001: At the unit, in the office, at the window with the sash down and the ledge along the bottom of it. He has six lines on the back of a delivery note: the six jobs of the season, house by house, and a figure against five of them. He reads them on the ledge where the light comes along it and finds that the one without a figure is the two bed frames, and that the five with figures on them were paid for out of a tin by a woman who was short of every one of them. He decides to go and ask to be entered, and he does not put anything else on the note. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: he has seen his own season laid out as a page and the page has no place on it for him. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: the frontage is in front of him and the bag is empty, which has not happened once in ten years.
cards.1002: At number ten, at the front room's window and its sill, with the room shut since the summer and the sash down on the sill. The woman of the house wants the sash out of the frame so the room can be let while her sister is away, and she will pay him. He asks her, and it is the first question he has put to anybody that is the right one: whether she has ever been on a book. She says no, and she says it without any trouble at all. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: he has got the answer he got himself, and he has told a woman about the book, which he has not done before. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he decides who he is going to ask, and it is her, which is the worst answer available to him.
cards.1003: At the lock-up, in the far bay, which nobody uses, with the roof high and dark below the glass and a plate of floor under his boots. He asks the woman who books work to enter him, and she refuses him with the reason she gave him in the previous block, which is that the last crew she asked came back and were not entered again, and with what the book needs, which is a request and a room with other people in it. He tells her he does not want her to ask him and names the woman he means to ask. She tells him what that will be, which is a favour and not a request, and that the difference between the two is a thing nobody has ever been able to put in a frame on a wall. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: he has said out loud, in a room, that he means to use the one woman in this street who has never been asked for anything. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he goes to twelve and does not tell her what he is going to ask her, which is the one thing he learned at number ten and is now using wrongly.
cards.1004: At number twelve, in the coal shed, at the wall inside it, which is lime and old brick and has been at the weather since before the war and has lost the lime off the face of the courses. The sister is in the shed doorway. She asks him for something, and what she asks for is that he come back after the season and put his name at the bottom of a list of the six houses, house by house, and that she will keep it, and that she will tell anybody who asks that he is the man who did it. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: it is not the book, it is not work, it will not help him, and she is spending the only thing she has — being able to ask somebody — on him. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: he is named, on a page, in a house, by a woman who had to ask him first, and the season is closing and the book shuts.

declared_ordinary_word.sense: WITH NO HOLLOW IN IT AND NO RISE ALONG IT, THE WHOLE LENGTH OF THE THING. ONE SENSE ONLY, AND IT IS A SENSE ABOUT A RUN, A LINE OR AN EDGE AND NEVER ABOUT A PERSON, A DEAL OR A SHADE.
declared_ordinary_word.why_this_word: THE RUN SO FAR IS ROUGH, SLICK, BLUNT, BRITTLE, STIFF, COLD, DAMP AND TRUE, AND EVEN IS NOT ANY OF THEM. TRUE WAS A WORD ABOUT A THING AGAINST WHAT IT IS SET AGAINST; EVEN IS A WORD ABOUT THE RUN OF A THING ALONG ITS OWN LENGTH, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT MEASUREMENT AND IS THE ONE THIS BLOCK MAKES, BECAUSE THE MAN IS LEARNING WHAT A WHOLE THING IS WORTH AND KEEPS FINDING THAT THE WORTH IS EVEN ALONG ITS LENGTH AND NO MORE THAN THAT AT ANY ONE POINT ON IT.
declared_ordinary_word.forms_not_used: EVENLY IS NOT USED. THE ADVERBS AND PARTICLES ARE NOT USED AT ALL: EVEN SO, EVEN THEN, EVEN NOW, EVEN THE, EVEN AT, EVEN FROM AND EVEN IF ARE BANNED WITHIN THIS BLOCK, AND SO IS EVEN WITH IN ITS SENSE OF TOLERATING; EVEN WITH IN THE SENSE OF LEVEL WITH IS ALLOWED AND APPEARS ONCE, AT 1003. THE MEASURE AFTER PROSE TAKES EVERY ONE OF THOSE AND GIVES A NUMBER AGAINST EACH.
declared_ordinary_word.density: AT NO MORE THAN ABOUT ONE USE IN EVERY HUNDRED WORDS, NEVER TWO IN ONE SENTENCE, A DIFFERENT MATERIAL BEHIND EACH ONE, BARE WORD AND THE PHRASE EVEN ALONG IT, COMPARATIVE AT ZERO. MUST RUN IN ALL TEN.
